source_policy: Independently published official authored web documentation is eligible for factual observation. The Suki repository has no established reuse permission and was not read. No complete unlicensed page was saved. Live pages have no verified source commit; displayed dates are not deployment attestations.

pages.title: Permission System
pages.retrieval_method: dot cloud browser, visible rendered article
pages.summary: Narrative explains authentication, OAuth scope matching, superuser handling, permission nodes/groups and punishment restrictions. Remote middleware delegates to a permission RPC. Its public discovery path lists keys.
pages.remaining_gap: No arbitrary-principal HTTP decision contract, RPC wire layout, full failure mapping or current cache freshness semantics is established.
pages.retained_content: Factual summary and provenance only; no complete prose, HTML, code examples, schema export or screenshot retained.

pages.title: Tag Ownership API
pages.retrieval_method: dot cloud browser, visible rendered article
pages.summary: Documents eight tag fields (id, slug, name, description, owner_publisher_id, is_protected, is_event, event_ends_at), ownership/protection/event operations and protected-tag quota.
pages.remaining_gap: Pinned list code also populates Usage. Inherited fields, complete serialized relationships and quota wrapper are not specified; documented admin policy differs from pinned action attributes.
pages.retained_content: Factual summary and provenance only; no complete prose, HTML, code examples, schema export or screenshot retained.

pages.title: OAuth Authentication
pages.summary: Authored form-based authorization/device/refresh flows, token/userinfo response examples, scopes, PKCE and polling/error behavior are available.
pages.remaining_gap: Examples use /padlock while current authored Solian callers use /stargate. This is not a global authority decision or deployed endpoint verification.
pages.retained_content: Factual summary and provenance only; no complete prose, HTML, code examples, schema export or screenshot retained.

pages.title: Multi-Factor Login
pages.retrieval_method: dot cloud browser, visible rendered article

pages.remaining_gap: Does not specify complete session JSON, current epoch/version validation, cache failure rules or per-request permission transport.
pages.retained_content: Factual summary and provenance only; no complete prose, HTML, code examples, schema export or screenshot retained.
